messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the Rate Limiter postmortem. We need owners + deadlines for customer comms: status page wording, 72h public summary, and RCA sharing policy (redaction/consent). Also call out any recurring patterns we should mention to customers. Who takes what?

ben: I can draft the status page update. Short TL;DR + SLO impact note. Will post initial text by tomorrow EOD. @liz can you do a legal/tone pass?

liz: Sounds good. I'll avoid wording like 'outage' if degraded but available. Prefer 'brief throttling event' or 'partial degradation'. Will flag any redaction needs.

sam: I'll own the RCA sharing follow-up. Plan: define public vs. detailed RCA recipients, redact internal IDs, and propose a consent flow for customers requesting full details. Target: Wed COB.

jordan: I'll add a short section on recurring incident signals for the 72h summary and link to the remediation tracker. Noting 2 similar events in the last 90 days. ETA: tomorrow morning.

maria: I've added these to the postmortem action tracker: - Status page copy  owner: ben  due: 2026-03-27 EOD; - 72h external summary  owner: liz/jordan  due: 2026-03-25 23:59 UTC; - RCA sharing policy  owner: sam  due: 2026-03-25 COB; - Remediation update  owner: eng-sre  due: 2026-04-02.

ben: Draft status page copy: "We experienced a brief increase in request throttles (429s) caused by a misapplied quota routing rule. Impact: ~3% of requests for ~12 minutes. Mitigation: traffic reroute and hotfix. Next steps: permanent routing fix and improved observability. Updates: incidents@redwood.com." Feedback?

liz: Minor edits: remove exact internal durations from public text, add link to live status page, and include a short "what we're doing to prevent recurrence" bullet list. Legal: no customer names.

sam: Legal also requests a consent checkbox for customers who want the full detailed RCA; redact customer IDs unless we have permission. I'll draft consent text and email flow.

sre-bot: Postmortem filed: https://intra/redwood/postmortems/rl-2026-03-22-1. Action tracker updated.

maria: Thanks. For the 72h summary include an impact matrix (who, what, duration), mitigation steps, recurring-pattern note, and a single POC for customers. I'll set reminders and nudge owners 24h before due dates.
